items.note: 沒有助動詞、過去 → 派 did，動詞回原形。
句子裡有 be（are）→ 直接搬。
wh- 字放前面，後面派 do。
who 自己是主詞，不用搬。
s 給 does 扛，動詞回原形。

items.q: We have ______ stock at the moment.
I ______ think that will work.（我不認為那行得通）
items.note: 否定放在 think 前面。

items.q: 你收到我昨天寄的檔案了嗎？
items.a: Did you receive the file I sent yesterday?
items.note: did 扛過去，receive 回原形。

items.q: 我不確定他明天會不會來開會。
items.a: I'm not sure if he will attend the meeting tomorrow.
items.note: if 後面要有一個時態完整的動詞：will attend 或 is attending。

items.q: 可以請你星期五前寄報價給我嗎？
items.a: Could you send me the quotation by Friday?
items.note: 對客戶／主管用 Could you…?

items.a: We don't have any stock right now. / We have no stock at the moment.

items.q: 恐怕我們沒辦法在星期五前出貨。
items.a: I'm afraid we can't ship by Friday.
items.note: I'm afraid 開頭是委婉否定的固定說法。
